verses.en: Ha-Mim

verses.ar: عٓسٓقٓ
verses.en: Ain. Sin. Qaf

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَ يُوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡكَ وَاِلَي الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَۙ اللّٰهُ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
verses.en: Thus doth (He) send inspiration to thee as (He did) to those before thee,- Allah, Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom

verses.ar: لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَلِيُّ الۡعَظِيۡمُ
verses.en: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and on earth: and He is Most High, Most Great

verses.ar: تَكَادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡ فَوۡقِهِنَّ وَالۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ لِمَنۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُ
verses.en: The heavens are almost rent asunder from above them (by Him Glory): and the angels celebrate the Praises of their Lord, and pray for forgiveness for (all) beings on earth: Behold! Verily Allah is He, the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اَوۡلِيَآءَ اللّٰهُ حَفِيۡظٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡؗۖ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِوَكِيۡلٍ
verses.en: And those who take as protectors others besides Him,- Allah doth watch over them; and thou art not the disposer of their affairs

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ قُرۡاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنۡذِرَ اُمَّ الۡقُرٰي وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَتُنۡذِرَ يَوۡمَ الۡجَمۡعِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهِؕ فَرِيۡقٌ فِي الۡجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيۡقٌ فِي السَّعِيۡرِ
verses.en: Thus have We sent by inspiration to thee an Arabic Qur'an: that thou mayest warn the Mother of Cities and all around her,- and warn (them) of the Day of Assembly, of which there is no doubt: (when) some will be in the Garden, and some in the Blazing Fire

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَجَعَلَهُمۡ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّلٰكِنۡ يُّدۡخِلُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ فِيۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖؕ وَالظّٰلِمُوۡنَ مَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيۡرٍ
verses.en: If Allah had so willed, He could have made them a single people; but He admits whom He will to His Mercy; and the Wrong-doers will have no protector nor helper

verses.ar: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اَوۡلِيَآءَۚ فَاللّٰهُ هُوَ الۡوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحۡيِ الۡمَوۡتٰيؗ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌࣖ‏
verses.en: What! Have they taken (for worship) protectors besides Him? But it is Allah,- He is the Protector, and it is He Who gives life to the dead: It is He Who has power over all things

verses.ar: وَمَا اخۡتَلَفۡتُمۡ فِيۡهِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ فَحُكۡمُهٗ٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبِّيۡ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُࣗۖ وَاِلَيۡهِ اُنِيۡبُ
verses.en: Whatever it be wherein ye differ, the decision thereof is with Allah: such is Allah my Lord: In Him I trust, and to Him I turn

verses.ar: فَاطِرُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ جَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡ اَزۡوَاجًا وَّمِنَ الۡاَنۡعَامِ اَزۡوَاجًاۚ يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيۡهِؕ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهٖ شَيۡءٌۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡبَصِيۡرُ
verses.en: (He is) the Creator of the heavens and the earth: He has made for you pairs from among yourselves, and pairs among cattle: by this means does He multiply you: there is nothing whatever like unto Him, and He is the One that hears and sees (all things)

verses.ar: لَهٗ مَقَالِيۡدُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِۚ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُؕ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth: He enlarges and restricts. The Sustenance to whom He will: for He knows full well all things

verses.ar: شَرَعَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ الدِّيۡنِ مَا وَصّٰي بِهٖ نُوۡحًا وَّالَّذِيۡ٘ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ وَمَا وَصَّيۡنَا بِهٖ٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَمُوۡسٰي وَعِيۡسٰ٘ي اَنۡ اَقِيۡمُوا الدِّيۡنَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوۡا فِيۡهِؕ كَبُرَ عَلَي الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ مَا تَدۡعُوۡهُمۡ اِلَيۡهِؕ اَللّٰهُ يَجۡتَبِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِ مَنۡ يُّنِيۡبُؕ‏
verses.en: The same religion has He established for you as that which He enjoined on Noah - the which We have sent by inspiration to thee - and that which We enjoined on Abraham, Moses, and Jesus: Namely, that ye should remain steadfast in religion, and make no divisions therein: to those who worship other things than Allah, hard is the (way) to which thou callest them. Allah chooses to Himself those whom He pleases, and guides to Himself those who turn (to Him)

verses.ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ الۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيًاۭ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّي لَّقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ وَاِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡرِثُوا الۡكِتٰبَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لَفِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيۡبٍ
verses.en: And they became divided only after Knowledge reached them,- through selfish envy as between themselves. Had it not been for a Word that went forth before from thy Lord, (tending) to a Term appointed, the matter would have been settled between them: But truly those who have inherited the Book after them are in suspicious (disquieting) doubt concerning it

verses.ar: فَلِذٰلِكَ فَادۡعُۚ وَاسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَا٘ اُمِرۡتَۚ وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَقُلۡ اٰمَنۡتُ بِمَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ كِتٰبٍۚ وَاُمِرۡتُ لِاَعۡدِلَ بَيۡنَكُمۡؕ اَللّٰهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمۡؕ لَنَا٘ اَعۡمَالُنَا وَلَكُمۡ اَعۡمَالُكُمۡؕ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمۡؕ اَللّٰهُ يَجۡمَعُ بَيۡنَنَاۚ وَاِلَيۡهِ الۡمَصِيۡرُؕ‏
verses.en: Now then, for that (reason), call (them to the Faith), and stand steadfast as thou art commanded, nor follow thou their vain desires; but say: "I believe in the Book which Allah has sent down; and I am commanded to judge justly between you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord: for us (is the responsibility for) our deeds, and for you for your deeds. There is no contention between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and to Him is (our) Final Goal

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يُحَآجُّوۡنَ فِي اللّٰهِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا اسۡتُجِيۡبَ لَهٗ حُجَّتُهُمۡ دَاحِضَةٌ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَعَلَيۡهِمۡ غَضَبٌ وَّلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ شَدِيۡدٌ
verses.en: But those who dispute concerning Allah after He has been accepted,- futile is their dispute in the Sight of their Lord: on them will be a Penalty terrible

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡزَلَ الۡكِتٰبَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَالۡمِيۡزَانَؕ وَمَا يُدۡرِيۡكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِيۡبٌ
verses.en: It is Allah Who has sent down the Book in Truth, and the Balance (by which to weigh conduct). And what will make thee realise that perhaps the Hour is close at hand

verses.ar: يَسۡتَعۡجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهَاۚ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مُشۡفِقُوۡنَ مِنۡهَاۙ وَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ اَنَّهَا الۡحَقُّؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يُمَارُوۡنَ فِي السَّاعَةِ لَفِيۡ ضَلٰلٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍ
verses.en: Only those wish to hasten it who believe not in it: those who believe hold it in awe, and know that it is the Truth. Behold, verily those that dispute concerning the Hour are far astray

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ لَطِيۡفٌۭ بِعِبَادِهٖ يَرۡزُقُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ الۡقَوِيُّ الۡعَزِيۡزُࣖ‏
verses.en: Gracious is Allah to His servants: He gives Sustenance to whom He pleases: and He has power and can carry out His Will

verses.ar: مَنۡ كَانَ يُرِيۡدُ حَرۡثَ الۡاٰخِرَةِ نَزِدۡ لَهٗ فِيۡ حَرۡثِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ كَانَ يُرِيۡدُ حَرۡثَ الدُّنۡيَا نُؤۡتِهٖ مِنۡهَاۙ وَمَا لَهٗ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ مِنۡ نَّصِيۡبٍ
verses.en: To any that desires the tilth of the Hereafter, We give increase in his tilth, and to any that desires the tilth of this world, We grant somewhat thereof, but he has no share or lot in the Hereafter

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكٰٓؤُا شَرَعُوۡا لَهُمۡ مِّنَ الدِّيۡنِ مَا لَمۡ يَاۡذَنۭۡ بِهِ اللّٰهُؕ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةُ الۡفَصۡلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ وَاِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: What! have they partners (in godhead), who have established for them some religion without the permission of Allah? Had it not been for the Decree of Judgment, the matter would have been decided between them (at once). But verily the Wrong-doers will have a grievous Penalty

verses.ar: تَرَي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ مُشۡفِقِيۡنَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوۡا وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۭ بِهِمۡؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فِيۡ رَوۡضٰتِ الۡجَنّٰتِۚ لَهُمۡ مَّا يَشَآءُوۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡفَضۡلُ الۡكَبِيۡرُ
verses.en: Thou wilt see the Wrong-doers in fear on account of what they have earned, and (the burden of) that must (necessarily) fall on them. But those who believe and work righteous deeds will be in the luxuriant meads of the Gardens: they shall have, before their Lord, all that they wish for. That will indeed be the magnificent Bounty (of Allah)

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ الَّذِيۡ يُبَشِّرُ اللّٰهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِؕ قُلۡ لَّا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ اَجۡرًا اِلَّا الۡمَوَدَّةَ فِي الۡقُرۡبٰيؕ وَمَنۡ يَّقۡتَرِفۡ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدۡ لَهٗ فِيۡهَا حُسۡنًاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوۡرٌ شَكُوۡرٌ
verses.en: That is (the Bounty) whereof Allah gives Glad Tidings to His Servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say: "No reward do I ask of you for this except the love of those near of kin." And if any one earns any good, We shall give him an increase of good in respect thereof: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Ready to appreciate (service)

verses.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ افۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاۚ فَاِنۡ يَّشَاِ اللّٰهُ يَخۡتِمۡ عَلٰي قَلۡبِكَؕ وَيَمۡحُ اللّٰهُ الۡبَاطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الۡحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ
verses.en: What! Do they say, "He has forged a falsehood against Allah"? But if Allah willed, He could seal up thy heart. And Allah blots out Vanity, and proves the Truth by His Words. For He knows well the secrets of all hearts

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ يَقۡبَلُ التَّوۡبَةَ عَنۡ عِبَادِهٖ وَيَعۡفُوۡا عَنِ السَّيِّاٰتِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَفۡعَلُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: He is the One that accepts repentance from His Servants and forgives sins: and He knows all that ye do

verses.ar: وَيَسۡتَجِيۡبُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَيَزِيۡدُهُمۡ مِّنۡ فَضۡلِهٖؕ وَالۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ شَدِيۡدٌ
verses.en: And He listens to those who believe and do deeds of righteousness, and gives them increase of His Bounty: but for the Unbelievers their is a terrible Penalty

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ بَسَطَ اللّٰهُ الرِّزۡقَ لِعِبَادِهٖ لَبَغَوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلٰكِنۡ يُّنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَآءُؕ اِنَّهٗ بِعِبَادِهٖ خَبِيۡرٌۭ بَصِيۡرٌ
verses.en: If Allah were to enlarge the provision for His Servants, they would indeed transgress beyond all bounds through the earth; but he sends (it) down in due measure as He pleases. For He is with His Servants Well-acquainted, Watchful

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ يُنَزِّلُ الۡغَيۡثَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا قَنَطُوۡا وَيَنۡشُرُ رَحۡمَتَهٗؕ وَهُوَ الۡوَلِيُّ الۡحَمِيۡدُ
verses.en: He is the One that sends down rain (even) after (men) have given up all hope, and scatters His Mercy (far and wide). And He is the Protector, Worthy of all Praise

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ خَلۡقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيۡهِمَا مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍؕ وَهُوَ عَلٰي جَمۡعِهِمۡ اِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيۡرٌࣖ‏
verses.en: And among His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the living creatures that He has scattered through them: and He has power to gather them together when He wills

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَصَابَكُمۡ مِّنۡ مُّصِيۡبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡكُمۡ وَيَعۡفُوۡا عَنۡ كَثِيۡرٍؕ‏
verses.en: Whatever misfortune happens to you, is because on the things your hands have wrought, and for many (of them) He grants forgiveness

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِۚۖ وَمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيۡرٍ
verses.en: Nor can ye frustrate (aught), (fleeing) through the earth; nor have ye, besides Allah, any one to protect or to help

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهِ الۡجَوَارِ فِي الۡبَحۡرِ كَالۡاَعۡلَامِؕ‏
verses.en: And among His Signs are the ships, smooth-running through the ocean, (tall) as mountains

verses.ar: اِنۡ يَّشَاۡ يُسۡكِنِ الرِّيۡحَ فَيَظۡلَلۡنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلٰي ظَهۡرِهٖؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُوۡرٍۙ‏
verses.en: If it be His Will He can still the Wind: then would they become motionless on the back of the (ocean). Verily in this are Signs for everyone who patiently perseveres and is grateful

verses.ar: اَوۡ يُوۡبِقۡهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوۡا وَيَعۡفُ عَنۡ كَثِيۡرٍۙ‏
verses.en: Or He can cause them to perish because of the (evil) which (the men) have earned; but much doth He forgive

verses.ar: وَّيَعۡلَمَ الَّذِيۡنَ يُجَادِلُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِنَاؕ مَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّحِيۡصٍ
verses.en: But let those know, who dispute about Our Signs, that there is for them no way of escape

verses.ar: فَمَا٘ اُوۡتِيۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۚ وَمَا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَبۡقٰي لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Whatever ye are given (here) is (but) a convenience of this life: but that which is with Allah is better and more lasting: (it is) for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَجۡتَنِبُوۡنَ كَبٰٓئِرَ الۡاِثۡمِ وَالۡفَوَاحِشَ وَاِذَا مَا غَضِبُوۡا هُمۡ يَغۡفِرُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Those who avoid the greater crimes and shameful deeds, and, when they are angry even then forgive

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَجَابُوۡا لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَاَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَࣕ وَاَمۡرُهُمۡ شُوۡرٰي بَيۡنَهُمۡࣕ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ يُنۡفِقُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Those who hearken to their Lord, and establish regular Prayer; who (conduct) their affairs by mutual Consultation; who spend out of what We bestow on them for Sustenance

verses.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا٘ اَصَابَهُمُ الۡبَغۡيُ هُمۡ يَنۡتَصِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And those who, when an oppressive wrong is inflicted on them, (are not cowed but) help and defend themselves

verses.ar: وَجَزٰٓؤُا سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثۡلُهَاۚ فَمَنۡ عَفَا وَاَصۡلَحَ فَاَجۡرُهٗ عَلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: The recompense for an injury is an injury equal thereto (in degree): but if a person forgives and makes reconciliation, his reward is due from Allah: for (Allah) loveth not those who do wrong

verses.ar: وَلَمَنِ انۡتَصَرَ بَعۡدَ ظُلۡمِهٖ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ سَبِيۡلٍؕ‏
verses.en: But indeed if any do help and defend themselves after a wrong (done) to them, against such there is no cause of blame

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا السَّبِيۡلُ عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ النَّاسَ وَيَبۡغُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: The blame is only against those who oppress men and wrong-doing and insolently transgress beyond bounds through the land, defying right and justice: for such there will be a penalty grievous

verses.ar: وَلَمَنۡ صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمِنۡ عَزۡمِ الۡاُمُوۡرِࣖ‏
verses.en: But indeed if any show patience and forgive, that would truly be an exercise of courageous will and resolution in the conduct of affairs

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ وَّلِيٍّ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖؕ وَتَرَي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ لَمَّا رَاَوُا الۡعَذَابَ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ هَلۡ اِلٰي مَرَدٍّ مِّنۡ سَبِيۡلٍۚ‏
verses.en: For any whom Allah leaves astray, there is no protector thereafter. And thou wilt see the Wrong-doers, when in sight of the Penalty, Say: "Is there any way (to effect) a return

verses.ar: وَتَرٰىهُمۡ يُعۡرَضُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهَا خٰشِعِيۡنَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ مِنۡ طَرۡفٍ خَفِيٍّؕ وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِنَّ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ الَّذِيۡنَ خَسِرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَاَهۡلِيۡهِمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ فِيۡ عَذَابٍ مُّقِيۡمٍ
verses.en: And thou wilt see them brought forward to the (Penalty), in a humble frame of mind because of (their) disgrace, (and) looking with a stealthy glance. And the Believers will say: "Those are indeed in loss, who have given to perdition their own selves and those belonging to them on the Day of Judgment. Behold! Truly the Wrong-doers are in a lasting Penalty

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ اَوۡلِيَآءَ يَنۡصُرُوۡنَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ سَبِيۡلٍؕ‏
verses.en: And no protectors have they to help them, other than Allah. And for any whom Allah leaves to stray, there is no way (to the Goal)

verses.ar: اِسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لِرَبِّكُمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَ يَوۡمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِؕ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّلۡجَاٍ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ وَّمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ نَّكِيۡرٍ
verses.en: Hearken ye to your Lord, before there come a Day which there will be no putting back, because of (the Ordainment of) Allah! that Day there will be for you no place of refuge nor will there be for you any room for denial (of your sins)

verses.ar: فَاِنۡ اَعۡرَضُوۡا فَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَفِيۡظًاؕ اِنۡ عَلَيۡكَ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُؕ وَاِنَّا٘ اِذَا٘ اَذَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَاۚ وَاِنۡ تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةٌۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ فَاِنَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ كَفُوۡرٌ
verses.en: If then they run away, We have not sent thee as a guard over them. Thy duty is but to convey (the Message). And truly, when We give man a taste of a Mercy from Ourselves, he doth exult thereat, but when some ill happens to him, on account of the deeds which his hands have sent forth, truly then is man ungrateful

verses.ar: لِلّٰهِ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُؕ يَهَبُ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ اِنَاثًا وَّيَهَبُ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ الذُّكُوۡرَۙ‏
verses.en: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He creates what He wills (and plans). He bestows (children) male or female according to His Will (and Plan)

verses.ar: اَوۡ يُزَوِّجُهُمۡ ذُكۡرَانًا وَّاِنَاثًاۚ وَيَجۡعَلُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ عَقِيۡمًاؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌ قَدِيۡرٌ
verses.en: Or He bestows both males and females, and He leaves barren whom He will: for He is full of Knowledge and Power

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ اَنۡ يُّكَلِّمَهُ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا وَحۡيًا اَوۡ مِنۡ وَّرَآئِ حِجَابٍ اَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ رَسُوۡلًا فَيُوۡحِيَ بِاِذۡنِهٖ مَا يَشَآءُؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيۡمٌ
verses.en: It is not fitting for a man that Allah should speak to him except by inspiration, or from behind a veil, or by the sending of a messenger to reveal, with Allah's permission, what Allah wills: for He is Most High, Most Wise

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ رُوۡحًا مِّنۡ اَمۡرِنَاؕ مَا كُنۡتَ تَدۡرِيۡ مَا الۡكِتٰبُ وَلَا الۡاِيۡمَانُ وَلٰكِنۡ جَعَلۡنٰهُ نُوۡرًا نَّهۡدِيۡ بِهٖ مَنۡ نَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاؕ وَاِنَّكَ لَتَهۡدِيۡ٘ اِلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍۙ‏
verses.en: And thus have We, by Our Command, sent inspiration to thee: thou knewest not (before) what was Revelation, and what was Faith; but We have made the (Qur'an) a Light, wherewith We guide such of Our servants as We will; and verily thou dost guide (men) to the Straight Way

verses.ar: صِرَاطِ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ اَلَا٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِ تَصِيۡرُ الۡاُمُوۡرُࣖ‏
verses.en: The Way of Allah, to Whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth. Behold (how) all affairs tend towards Allah
